definitions.gloss: to wear down, to be worn away, to erode
definitions.explanation: To become thinner or smaller through friction or repeated use. Used for physical objects and figuratively for mental energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{減|へ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{靴底|くつぞこ}→靴底：15486_kutsuzoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{減|へ}って⟦{滑|すべ}りやすく→滑りやすい：27611_suberiyasui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The soles of my shoes have worn down and become slippery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クレーム→クレーム：27399_kureemu⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{減|へ}る。
examples.english: Dealing with complaints every day wears my nerves down.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{減|へ}る.
Transitive pair: {擦|す}り{減|へ}らす (to wear something down)

FORMS:
{擦|す}る (to rub) + ⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ (to decrease) = to decrease through rubbing

ASPECT (ている):
{擦|す}り{減|へ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a resulting state of being worn down.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{減|へ}る: tires wear down
- ⟦{靴底|くつぞこ}→靴底：15486_kutsuzoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{減|へ}る: shoe soles wear away
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{減|へ}る: nerves get frayed
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{減|へ}る: teeth get worn down
